issues.detail: The Hebrew distinguishes 'מִקְנֵנוּ' (our cattle/herds) from 'וְכָל בְּהֶמְתֵּנוּ' (and all our beasts/animals). The Chinese renders both as '牲畜' (livestock), losing the distinction between the two categories, and the phrase '一切牲畜' (all livestock) does not fully convey 'all our beasts' as a separate category from 'our cattle'.
